title: Stable descending priority order
spec: Implement queue_order(tickets). tickets is a list of (ticket_id, priority) pairs. Priorities are mutually comparable values, for example integers or tuples, and need not be numeric. Return the list of ticket IDs ordered from highest to lowest priority; tickets with equal priority keep their original relative order (earlier submissions first). Do not modify tickets.
target_defect: Reversing an ascending sort also reverses the order of tickets with equal priority.
author_rationale: Support non-numeric priorities such as tuples, which cannot be negated.
limitations: Synthetic module written by the repository's AI engineering agent after the November 2026 development pilot saturated corpus v1, before any model reviewed it. Designed around omissions, cross-function effects and edge cases stated in the contract. Not a natural pull request; correct means conforming to the stated contract and supplied checks.
